entries.title: Job 25:1
segments: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 25:2
segments: Rule and fear are with Him; [He] makes peace in His high places.

entries.title: Job 25:3
segments: Is there any number of His armies? And on whom does not His light arise?

entries.title: Job 25:4
segments: How then can man be justified with God? Or how can [one] who is born of a woman be clean?

entries.title: Job 25:5
segments: Look even to [the] moon, and it shines not; yea, the stars are not pure in His sight;

entries.title: Job 25:6
segments: how much less man [who is] a maggot, and the son of man, [who is] a worm?
